note: omc skill frontmatter: name and description

to.section: Use when: session uncovered a repeatable workflow worth a reusable skill
Goal: capture a successful multi-step workflow as a concrete skill draft
Quality gate: not googleable, codebase-specific, took real effort; prefer heuristics and pitfalls
Workflow: identify task; extract inputs, steps, criteria, pitfalls, evidence, target; choose built-in, learned skill, or docs only
Draft a complete skill file with frontmatter; never plain markdown; minimum frontmatter fields
Storage paths for learned skills; worktree-local until committed; draft triggers and steps; flag fuzzy parts
Rules: only repeatable workflows; practical scope; explicit criteria; note branching decisions; keep omc-learned name
Output: proposed name, target location, draft or structure, quality notes, open questions
